parts.text: A hospital network uses star topology for medical devices in each department and bus topology to connect departments to the central server. A single cable failure in the bus segment caused multiple star-connected devices to lose connectivity intermittently. Analyze why this hybrid topology created unexpected interdependencies and propose an improved topology that stays cost-effective while removing this vulnerability.

All network sources are bursty (they only occasionally have data to send). Would packet switching or circuit switching be more desirable? Compare packet switching with circuit switching for this traffic scenario.

Seven 7-bit data streams: 1110110, 1101010, 0111110, 0110100, 1100010, 0010101, 1100000. A row parity bit is added to every 7 bits to make a byte, and an extra byte is added for column parity (even parity). Determine all the row and column parity bits.
i. Can this code identify all two-bit errors?
ii. Can this code identify all three-bit errors?
Justify your answers.

Two computers use stop-and-wait ARQ. RTT is 2 ms, timeout is twice the RTT, and both use sequence numbers on data and ACK frames. The sender sends 8 frames; the first 3 go through without incident (Figure 2). Draw the sequence of steps if:

ii. The 5th frame is lost on the first attempt, acknowledged after the second. [2]
iii. The 6th frame is sent and acknowledged without incident. [1]
iv. The 7th frame is sent without incident but its acknowledgment is lost the first time; acknowledged on the second attempt. [2]

A chat application uses Hamming code for error correction on 8-bit messages with even parity. The message 10101011 is prepared for transmission; at the receiver the 6th bit is corrupted.
i. Determine the data to be transferred after applying Hamming code with even parity (show all steps). [5]
ii. If the 6th bit is received incorrectly, demonstrate how Hamming code detects and corrects the error. [5]

parts.label: b
parts.text: i. A remote sensor station uses Selective Repeat ARQ with a 4-bit sequence number. The sensor sends Frames 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4; Frame 1 is lost, the acknowledgement of Frame 2 is lost, and the acknowledgement of Frame 3 times out. Discuss the Selective Repeat ARQ protocol and draw the timing diagram including lost frames, retransmissions and delays. [6]

parts.label: b (ii)
parts.text: ii. Which CSMA is suitable for Ethernet? Why? Justify with valid key points. [4]

A new high-speed multimedia application bypasses the transport layer and directly communicates with the network layer for latency reduction. Analyze the architectural consequences of this design. Under what conditions could such a violation actually improve performance?
A remote surgery system requires 99.999% reliability and under 5 ms latency. Evaluate whether packet switching or circuit switching is more appropriate. Justify with quantitative arguments.

Two satellite ground stations communicate with a satellite using ALOHA. Station A uses pure ALOHA and Station B uses slotted ALOHA. The channel data rate is 1 Mbps and both stations have the same average packet generation rate.
a) Analyze the performance of pure and slotted ALOHA in terms of throughput and efficiency in this scenario.
b) Discuss the factors that influence the performance difference between pure and slotted ALOHA.
c) Propose a strategy to optimize the performance of both stations considering the satellite channel and the ALOHA protocol.

The bit stream 1101011011 is transmitted using the standard CRC method with generator polynomial 10011. Show the generation of the code word and the actual bit stream transmitted if the third bit from the left is inverted during transmission. How would this error be detected at the receiver's end?

An ISP is granted a block of addresses starting with 150.80.0.0/16 and wants to distribute them to 2600 customers: a) the first group has 200 medium-size businesses, each needing about 128 addresses; b) the second group has 400 small businesses, each needing about 16 addresses; c) the third group has 2000 households, each needing 4 addresses. Design the subblocks and give the slash notation for each subblock. Find how many addresses are still available after these allocations.

An IP datagram of 4000 bytes (including header) must pass through a network with MTU = 1500 bytes. Calculate the number of fragments created. Determine the fragment offsets, fragment sizes and More Fragment (MF) flags. Explain the entire fragmentation process.

Calculate the LSP for nodes A, B and E, and give the steps to be followed in Link State Routing. Apply Dijkstra's algorithm to the given graph (A-B 12, A-C 7, A-D 10, B-C 3, B-E 4, C-E 9) to form the shortest path tree and construct the routing table for Node A, the root node.

A network engineer claims that TCP congestion control and TCP flow control solve the same problem. Critically evaluate this statement. Using a real-world scenario of a high-bandwidth server communicating with a slow client over a congested network, explain how both mechanisms operate simultaneously. What would happen if one of them were removed?

parts.label: a
parts.text: A network administrator must manage traffic for three services: Video streaming, Email transfer and Financial transactions. Design a traffic management strategy ensuring fair bandwidth allocation while prioritizing critical services. Explain which queuing mechanism would be most suitable and justify your reasoning.

parts.label: b
parts.text: A telecommunications provider promises low delay, high throughput, minimal packet loss and low jitter. Explain why achieving all these parameters simultaneously is difficult in real networks. Analyse the trade-offs and suggest how networks prioritize QoS parameters depending on application type.

parts.label: a
parts.text: A user accesses a website and downloads a file while simultaneously sending an email. Trace the interaction of the following protocols: DNS, HTTP, SMTP, TCP, IP. Explain how these protocols cooperate across layers.

parts.label: b
parts.text: You are designing a new application layer protocol for IoT devices. Explain what features it must include to support low bandwidth, high scalability, security and low latency. Compare your design with existing protocols like HTTP or MQTT.
